description: Look up current documentation for a code library or framework. Returns the passages and code examples that fit a question. The lookup is run by a documentation provider (Context7, or the vendor's own documentation server for Microsoft, AWS and Cloudflare), which is named in the reply's `via` field.

library.description: Library or framework name, for example next.js, convex, stripe.

max_result_tokens.description: Cap on the size of the reply. Default 3000, at most 6000.

question.description: What you need to know about it.

name: stork_docs
title: Look up library documentation
